INDIGOTAILOR-POTION_INDIGO_DYE.title: Indigo Dye
INDIGOTAILOR-POTION_INDIGO_DYE.descripti: Add 1 Needle Embryo+, 1 Cloth Embryo+, and 1 Thread Embryo+ to hand.
INDIGOTAILOR-POTION_THIMBLE_OIL.title: Thimble Oil
INDIGOTAILOR-POTION_THIMBLE_OIL.descript: This turn, the cards in your hand count as being at the [aqua]Selvedge[/aqua]. Each card that can be enchanted gains a 4-Block Patch.
INDIGOTAILOR-POTION_ATROPOS_SHEARS.title: Golden Shears Potion
INDIGOTAILOR-POTION_ATROPOS_SHEARS.descr: Apply 5 [aqua]Unravel[/aqua] to ALL enemies. Add an upgraded Embryo to your hand based on each enemy’s intent.
